items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: Then I played with Dude's Brothers Band, Foster Lewis. He had a band and we used to travel around on percentage.

ctx.x: I remember he made a tape of that.

Joe Yeah. Joe Well they had dude Foster Lewis was playing trumpet on that at that time. And we cut that tape for Dick. Well he left the enemy on the way to California somewhere and I think his friend died. Joe Well when he got out the service he decided to come down here he wanted to see a carnival. He had never seen a carnival. Joe So I told him I said well Dick I think if you come down there you'll like it. Joe Well sure enough he can and he like it enough to make it at home. Joe He stayed down there. Joe…
Joe I'm trying to think of those Saturday night dances. Joe I went to only two or three of them I guess. Joe Ten years ago. Joe Was that at the Buzzards Club every other Saturday wasn't it?
